command:
set -euo pipefail
echo 'BINARIES'
for b in pw-cat pw-play wpctl pactl paplay aplay ffplay python3; do printf '%s=' "$b"; command -v "$b" || true; done
echo 'PW_CAT_HELP'
(pw-cat --help 2>&1 || true) | head -80
echo 'DEFAULT_AUDIO'
(wpctl status 2>/dev/null || pactl info 2>/dev/null || true) | head -120
echo 'PY_AUDIO_MODULES'
python3 - <<'PY'
import importlib.util, json
print(json.dumps({m: bool(importlib.util.find_spec(m)) for m in ['sounddevice','pyaudio','soundfile','numpy']}, sort_keys=True))
PY
